C-INTERNATIONAL-TERMINOLOGY.IntentSummary: Correct naming at the existing source owners, preserve functional scope, regenerate and verify both portal languages.

T-001.Title: Reconcile fixed names and governing meanings in both language sources

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Fixed international terms, Russian explanations and AICC-specific concepts are applied according to the shared reference; inflection, document references and paired meanings remain coherent.

Verification.Evidence: Reviewed term occurrences, exceptions and changed-source inventory.

T-002.Title: Rebuild and verify the complete bilingual portal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All pages, navigation, diagrams, tooltips and search reflect source terminology with intact links and language counterparts.

Verification.Evidence: Whole-site terminology scan and representative browser journeys in both languages.
